title: The Davidic Covenant
subtitle: 1-2 Samuel, 1 Kings 1-11, Psalms I-II integrated
theme: God establishes his kingdom through a king. The covenant with David and its eternal promise.
memoryText: And your house and your kingdom shall be made sure forever before me. Your throne shall be established forever.
reviewQuestions: What is the covenant God makes with David in 2 Samuel 7?
How does David’s sin with Bathsheba illustrate both grace and consequence?
What makes Solomon’s reign both the high point and the beginning of the end?
What do the Messianic Psalms teach us about the kind of king God ultimately promises?
psalmsNote: The largest block. The psalms of David beside his story (32 and 51, 63, 34) and the royal and Zion psalms (2, 20, 21, 45, 72, 48, 84, 87, 101).
